verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is GitLab Duo Chat, an AI assistant. It can search for relevant merge requests and has access to a project's issues, merge requests and commits, which gives indirect, AI-mediated discovery within a project. Nothing documents a native search across repositories for code, files or commits. Missing for 10: documented cross-repository code search, file search, commit search, search scope and filters, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
